name: Code Review
scope: code reviewer · pinned Martian Core issues · not specialist-specific accuracy
score_definition: Reviewer Score = (3 × F1 + latency + $/run) ÷ 5. Each part is this row's place between the worst (0) and best (100) full-cohort row in this family — higher F1, lower latency and lower $/run score higher. Scored once F1, latency and $/run are all measured and at least 3 rows are.
ranking_basis: Sorted by Reviewer Score (F1 counts 3×, time and cost 1× each).
warnings: Local reviewer execution; no hosted queue or GitHub delivery measurement.
One trial per declared configuration and PR; exploratory comparison.
Pinned source issue matching is not independent finding adjudication.
250 cells are admitted unchanged from the experiments that paid for them (identical case identity, engine and output ceiling, on the runtime of their configuration); they are never re-bought.
Precision is golden-issue matching precision, not independently adjudicated finding correctness.
Competitor outputs are historical; fresh IonWarp runs use the same PR heads and new semantic grading.
Available-evidence checkpoint: unstarted jobs and completed but ungraded outputs remain explicit missing coverage. Scores use only saved grades under the named protocol.
